name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout doubles Archivist of Oghma's triggered ability

prerequisites.timing: Any time an opponent searches their library (tutors, fetchlands, etc.), while both Delney and Archivist of Oghma are on the battlefield.
other: Delney's oracle text: 'If a triggered ability of a creature you control with power 2 or less triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.'

Archivist of Oghma's oracle text: 'Whenever an opponent searches their library, you gain 1 life and draw a card.' Power is 2 (confirmed via data/cards_cache/oracle-2026-08-12/, scryfall_id f6589e02-8c84-4069-88d1-ebcc8520cae1), so it qualifies for Delney's doubling.

Same structural pattern as the already-verified-candidate Delney doublings (INT-0007..0010: Orcish Bowmasters, Esper Sentinel, Runic Armasaur, Spellseeker) - added here because Archivist of Oghma was not among those originally checked and independently satisfies the same power<=2 + triggered-ability shape.

Effect is opponent-triggered (fires off any opponent's library search, not the controller's own action), so frequency depends on the opponents' decks/play patterns rather than being deck-controlled - noted as a caveat, not a blocker to candidacy.
Not a loop, not infinite - a straightforward doubling of a per-opponent-search value trigger (2 life + 2 cards instead of 1 life + 1 card, per qualifying opponent search).

result.summary: Each opponent library search triggers Archivist of Oghma's life-gain-and-draw ability twice instead of once (2 life + 2 cards per qualifying search) while both Delney and Archivist of Oghma are on the battlefield.

sources.reference: Independent scan of subject-deck creatures with power 2 or less and a triggered ability, cross-referenced against Delney's doubling clause, per the charter's named priority category 'Delney interactions'.
